newsitem.title: USA: Sabre to offer reservation system in CIS.
newsitem.headline: Sabre to offer reservation system in CIS.

text.p: Sabre Group Holdings Inc said a group it heads signed a $140 million contract Friday with International Technology Corp - Sirena to create products to modernize airline management technology for the Commonwealth of Independent States.

Called Sirena-3, the suite of products will be designed to improve the way airlines book reservations and manage fares, pricing, revenue accounting, passenger check-in, scheduling and yield management.
International Technology, a private Russian company located in Moscow, will manage and operate Sirena-3 and market it to CIS airlines.
Joining Sabre Group in the contract are International Business Machines Corp and AT&T Corp's AT&T Tridom. Sabre is partially-owned by AMR Corp.
Sabre said it was awarded the system integration contract for Sirena-3, incorporating Tridom's VSAT satellite tellecommunication system and IBM's S/390 mainframe.
The Export-Import Bank of the United States guaranteed a $90 million loan for the sale, Sabre said.

The Russian government has committed to providing a sovereign guarantee for the Sirena-3 project. Commerzbank AG's New York Branch, will provide the majority of the funds for the project. Llama Co of Arkansas contributed to the deal by granting a private $4.6 million loan.
